papers.title: Causal Semantic Alignment for LLM-based Time Series Forecasting (CVAformer)
papers.what: Splits each variable into invariant and dynamic parts before aligning a time series with language model embeddings, then applies a causal backdoor intervention so the dynamic part does not bias the alignment.
papers.builds_on: Time-LLM (MKICLA63); GPT4TS (6QQNUTL7); iTransformer (QBX2TI2X); Causal Inference Intro (BB78CC56)

papers.title: Adaptive Patching Is Harder Than It Looks for Time-Series Forecasting
papers.what: Shows that a tuned uniform patch size matches content-adaptive patching on long-horizon benchmarks, and explains in theory why a scalar local-complexity signal cannot by itself justify non-uniform patches.

papers.title: ARM: An AutoRegressive Large Multimodal Model with Unified Discrete Representations
papers.what: A 7B autoregressive model that does image understanding, generation, and editing with one shared discrete token vocabulary and next-token prediction, then uses reinforcement learning to lift task rewards (WISE 0.50 to 0.56, GEdit-Bench-EN 5.75 to 6.68).
papers.builds_on: Attention Is All You Need (PHB9VRVM); DALL-E 2 (DUERBZGM); Flamingo (SC8KWYVK)

papers.title: RLVR Implicitly Incentivizes Correct Reasoning in Base LLMs
papers.what: Introduces CoT-Pass@K, which scores a sample as correct only when both the answer and the reasoning steps are right, and uses it to show reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards extends the reasoning boundary, not just answer selection.
